align_cameras_extrinsics: align source cameras to target cameras using extrinsics mode with similarity transformation
align_cameras_centers: align source cameras to target cameras using centers mode with Umeyama algorithm
align_cameras_rigid: align source cameras to target cameras with rigid transform by disabling scale estimation
review_corresponding_cameras_alignment: review the corresponding_cameras_alignment function to understand the similarity transform math and alignment modes
summarize_align_camera_extrinsics: summarize the _align_camera_extrinsics function which uses SVD to compute global rotation and least squares for translation and scale
